title: Stationfall (Stationfall.z3.js)
source: historicalsource/stationfall verbs V-ON: LIGHTBIT objects get FSET ACTIVEBIT (plus ONBIT for HEADLAMP only) "Okay, the X is now on."; else "You can't turn that on." V-OFF: clears ACTIVEBIT (+ONBIT), "It isn't on!" if not active. ACTIVEBIT is also used on FLOYD (actor), LOG-READER, DRYER, PRESSER, JAMMER (station.zil:107/153), RADIO, FORKLIFT, PLATINUM-DETECTOR.
census: step 109: bit 24 (LIGHTBIT) on headlamp 141, jammer 233, log reader 29, SB radio 46, dryer 63, platinum detector 65, presser 69, nanofilm reader 145, eternal flame 205, innocuous machine 212 (+ garbage ids >=262). bit 26 (ACTIVEBIT) on Floyd 26, presser 69, headlamp (when on), eternal flame 205. bit 30 (ONBIT) on ~100 rooms (room-lit) and headlamp when on.

note: Headlamp 141 and jammer 233 both have native full cycles. Jammer (step 258, route sf-route2.json): take (33 -> player 218), turn on (+26 ACTIVEBIT, "Okay, the jammer is now on."), turn off (-26), off again ("It isn't on!", no change), on again (+26). Both word orders work (turn off/on jammer). The jammer gets no ONBIT 30 (it is not a light source); the headlamp gets 26 and 30. On-state: 26 is the native switch bit but is shared with Floyd, the eternal flame and the presser; 30 is room-lit plus headlamp light. Neither is a clean on-map, so I propose no attributeMap.on. Claude decides.
